StatWeave 80-Dataset Scientific Benchmark & Visual Atlas

80 verified datasets across 4 tracks: Core R Set (32), Track 1: Electrophysiology, ChEMBL Ion Channels & Dose–Response Pharmacology (16), Track 2: Biomedical, Clinical RCTs, Nested Designs & Survival (20), and Track 3: Messy Student Spreadsheet Benchmarks (12). Rendered 389 exploratory SVGs and 788 statistical combinations with 0 errors and 225 leak-free training/evaluation trajectories (79 independent study clusters). ChEMBL bioactivity records included under CC BY-SA 3.0.
